title: Competing gene regulatory networks drive naive and memory B cell differentiation.
authors: Demela, Pietro; Esposito, Laura; Marchesan, Pietro; Nossa, Leonardo; Bolognini, Davide; Giacopuzzi, Edoardo; Ricciardelli, Eugenia; Ferrari, Paolo; Bombelli, Silvia; Peano, Clelia; Prati, Daniele; Valenti, Luca; Soskic, Blagoje
one_liner_zh: 该文研究B细胞分化的基因调控网络，虽涉及转录因子IRF4和机器学习预测，但核心是转录组和细胞命运，未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Elucidating the gene regulatory networks (GRNs) that control human B cell differentiation is crucial for understanding immune responses to infection, vaccination, and autoimmunity. Here, we map the GRNs guiding naive and memory B cell differentiation. Early in activation, both cell types engage highly similar GRNs. However, at later stages, naive B cells diverge into two opposing GRNs that promote differentiation into either plasma cells or germinal center (GC) cells. In contrast, memory B cells predominantly activate the GRNs associated with plasma cell differentiation, such as IRF4. CRISPR perturbations of IRF4 and its downstream effector PRDM1 rewired the GRNs, blocking plasma cell programs and promoting GC fate. Finally, we trained machine learning algorithms to predict sister cells, solely based on the transcriptome. This showed that plasma cell gene expression is tightly correlated among sister cells, revealing heritable transcriptional programs. Collectively, our findings reveal distinct regulatory trajectories in naive and memory B cells and uncover heritable transcriptional states that shape human B cell fate decisions.
abstract_zh: 阐明控制人类B细胞分化的基因调控网络（GRNs）对于理解感染、疫苗接种和自身免疫的免疫反应至关重要。在此，我们绘制了指导初始B细胞和记忆B细胞分化的GRNs。在激活早期，两种细胞类型均涉及高度相似的GRNs。然而，在后期阶段，初始B细胞分化为两个相反的GRNs，分别促进向浆细胞或生发中心（GC）细胞的分化。相比之下，记忆B细胞主要激活与浆细胞分化相关的GRNs，如IRF4。对IRF4及其下游效应因子PRDM1的CRISPR扰动重塑了GRNs，阻断了浆细胞程序并促进了GC命运。最后，我们训练了机器学习算法，仅基于转录组预测姐妹细胞。这表明浆细胞基因表达在姐妹细胞间紧密相关，揭示了可遗传的转录程序。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了初始B细胞和记忆B细胞中不同的调控轨迹，并揭示了塑造人类B细胞命运决定的可遗传转录状态。
